note: Macon County GA publishes its official zoning map only as a static PDF (last updated about 2013/2014); the ordinance names the map but gives no service URL. No ArcGIS REST, WFS or open-data service of county zoning districts was found. The county's parcel viewer (Experience Builder) exposed no zoning service, and Dynamo Spatial and Regrid are commercial, not county-published. Montezuma's zoning map is kept at City Hall and adopted by reference from 1975, with no public service found. Oglethorpe, Ideal and Marshallville were not found publishing zoning either.
